name: Realizable Three-Section Criterion
statement: For a nonempty proper ample test $T\subsetneq Q^Y$, the associated three-section class $H_T$ is the strict sign class of affine forms on an open convex set exactly when $T$ is. Consequently every realizable ample test is universal. If $k=|Y|$ and $q_0,q_1$ count the minimal signed missing patterns of $T,T^{\mathrm c}$, respectively, $H_T$ has a rank-$(k+1)$ parent with at most $q_0+q_1+2k+2$ auxiliaries.
proof: A realization of $H_T$ restricts to its control sections and realizes $T$. Conversely, take independent strict signed separators for $T$ and its complement. Couple the first system to the upper control and the second to the lower control, together with an inequality excluding control word $10$. The resulting cone realizes precisely the three allowed sections. Normalize the control gap, add strict guard margins and a bounding box, and apply strict-realization completion.
